title: Transformer Neural Networks for Protein Family and Interaction Prediction Tasks
summary: Journal version of the ACM-BCB 2020 paper: a small transformer pretrained on protein sequences, fine-tuned for protein family classification and protein-protein interaction prediction at a fraction of the compute of larger models.
authors: Ananthan Nambiar; Simon Liu; Maeve Heflin; John Malcolm Forsyth; Sergei Maslov; Mark Hopkins; Anna M. Ritz
